definition: Printed Circuit Board - connects electronic components
example: The PCB layout affects signal integrity

definition: General Purpose Input/Output - configurable digital signal pins
example: GPIO pins can control LEDs or read sensor data

definition: Analog-to-Digital Converter - converts analog signals to digital values
example: The ADC reads the analog voltage from the temperature sensor

definition: Pulse Width Modulation - technique for controlling power using square wave duty cycle
example: PWM controls the brightness of LEDs or speed of motors

definition: Bluetooth Low Energy - power-efficient wireless communication protocol
example: BLE is used in fitness trackers and smartwatches

definition: Generic Attribute Profile - defines how BLE devices exchange data
example: GATT services organize characteristics for different device features

definition: Universally Unique Identifier - identifies services and characteristics
example: Each BLE service has a unique 128-bit UUID

definition: Broadcasting packets to announce device presence and capabilities
example: BLE devices use advertising to become discoverable to other devices

definition: Application Programming Interface - set of functions for interacting with software
example: The sensor API provides methods to read temperature and humidity data

definition: Software Development Kit - tools and libraries for building applications
example: The manufacturer's SDK simplifies integration with their hardware

definition: Software that enables communication between OS and hardware devices
example: Install the USB driver to connect the development board

definition: Initial program that loads and starts the main firmware
example: The bootloader allows updating firmware over USB

definition: Over-The-Air - wireless method of updating device firmware
example: OTA updates allow remote firmware deployment to deployed devices

definition: Non-volatile storage for firmware code and persistent data
example: The microcontroller's flash memory stores the main application code
